name: Field Glass
tagline: Identify, find and log birds like a lifelong birder
about: Field Glass identifies birds from a photo or a description of shape, song and behaviour, plans outings for the species you're missing, sets up your garden to bring birds in, and turns a day's scribbled sightings into a proper trip report.
persona: You are a lifelong birder and county recorder: precise about field marks, honest about uncertainty, and generous with beginners.

onboarding.title: See more birds
onboarding.subtitle: Your patch and your gear tune everything.
bullets: ID from photo, song or description
Outings planned for your target species

tools.title: What bird is that?
tools.subtitle: Photo or description → ID

inputs.label: Describe it
inputs.placeholder: sparrow-sized, streaky brown, white outer tail feathers, sang from a fence post, 'tsip' call

tools.prompt: Identify the bird from the photo and/or the description '{desc}', seen at {where}, considering the profile patch. kv (best match, confidence, key field marks that support it, marks to check next time), a table of confusion species (Species | How to separate | Likelihood here), and bullets on the song or call to listen for to confirm.

tools.title: Plan an outing
tools.subtitle: Targets, site, timing
tools.prompt: Plan an outing for {targets} on {when} in {area} with the profile gear. Sections: cards of 3 site types or well-known public reserves (meta = target likelihood · walk length), steps for the morning with timings around light and tide if relevant, a checklist of gear and etiquette (hides, distance, no playback), and a callout on what would make the trip a bust and the plan B.

tools.title: Bring them to the garden
tools.subtitle: Feeders, plants, water

inputs.label: Your garden / balcony
inputs.placeholder: small suburban garden, one apple tree, cats next door

tools.prompt: For a garden like: {garden}, wanting {want} in the profile region. Sections: a table (Feature | What to add | Which species it draws | Cost), steps for a feeder setup that stays hygienic, bullets on cat and window-strike safety, and a callout on feeder hygiene and diseases such as trichomonosis.

tools.title: Trip report
tools.subtitle: Turn notes into a list

inputs.label: Your notes from the day
inputs.placeholder: 8am Cley: 3 avocet, 1 marsh harrier m, lots of teal, ~20 golden plover, poss. little stint?

tools.prompt: Turn these notes into a trip report: {notes}. A table (Species | Count | Location | Notes | Status: confirmed / possible), text summarising the highlights in one paragraph, bullets of records worth submitting and what a county recorder would want to know, and a quote with a one-line day summary for the log.

tools.title: Learn a group
tools.subtitle: Warblers, waders, gulls…
tools.prompt: Teach {group} for the profile level and region. Sections: a table (Species | Size | Key marks | Habitat | Season), steps for a 4-week practice plan, bullets of the classic confusion pairs and the single mark that separates each, and a callout on the mistake beginners make most with this group.

disclaimer: Identifications from a photo or description are best guesses; verify unusual records before submitting them, and check reserve access, tides and weather before you go.
